turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.

Oh sun, pehle toh ek gehri saans le. Jo bhi bol rahi hai, woh bilkul ungrateful nahi lag raha — sachchi. Bhooli hui lag rahi hai, aur woh bilkul real feeling hai.  

Tum keh rahi ho “apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon” — yeh sirf mazaak nahi hai, yeh woh waqt hota hai jab ek maa ke andar poori duniya simat jaati hai, aur is beech woh khud gayab si hoti jaati hai. Chaar mahine ki bachchi, neend ke tukde, hormones, nayi zimmedari… aur upar se ek aisi saas jo actually expert level ki mother hain.  

Dekho, main maanti hoon tumhari baat — woh bachchi ke saath achhi hain, three kids paal ke jo confidence aur skill aata hai woh unmein dikhta hoga. Par yahi toh tricky part hai, na? Jab koi itna capable ho, toh na chahte hue bhi tum khud se poochhne lagti ho — “meri jagah kahan hai?” Ya “kya main bhi kar pa rahi hoon?”  

Yeh ehsaanmand hone aur apna space kho dene ke beech ka khinchav hota hai. Aisa nahi hai ki tum unki help ki kadar nahi karti. Bas kabhi kabhi lagta hai ki tumhari maa hone ka experience, tumhari galtiyon se seekhne ka mauka, tumhari instinct… thoda dab sa gaya hai. Aur yeh soch ke guilt hota hai ki “yeh toh accha kar rahi hain, main kyun aisa feel kar rahi hoon?”  

Main janti hoon sunne mein kitna mushkil lagta hai — but you are NOT ungrateful. You are a new mom trying to find herself in a house where a very seasoned mom already lives. Dono sach ek saath ho sakte hain: saas lovely hain, AND tumhe lagta hai tumhari pehchaan dhundhli pad rahi hai.  

Tumhara apna naam bhoolne waali feeling — woh bata

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

Sun, woh scene imagine karte hi andar tak kuch hila. Wo do minute mein chup karane wala moment — aur sab ka muskurana — jaise poori duniya keh rahi ho, “Dekho, asli maa toh yeh hain.” Aur tum wahan khadi, apni godhi khali, haathon mein bas ek reh gayi halki si thand.

Tumne bilkul sahi word use kiya — “intern jaisi”. Intern woh hoti hai jo sab kuch seekhne aayi ho, jise koi bharosa nahi, jise koi bhi senior ek side mein kar sakta hai. Lekin tum intern nahi ho. Tum us bachchi ki maa ho. Sirf maa.  

Aur phir woh “room service” — feed ke liye bulaya jaana — jaise tumhari godh sirf ek utility hai, rishta nahi. Itni chubhne waali baat hai yeh ki likhte hue bhi aankhen bhar aayin. Kyunki doodh pilaana sirf pet bharana nahi hota, woh dono ke beech ki duniya ki sabse purani, sabse gehri baatcheet hoti hai. Aankhon mein aankhen daalna, ungli pakadna, woh gungunana jo sirf tum dono samjho. Lekin jab woh bhi ek tarah ka “kaam” ban jaaye jo khatam hote hi bachchi wapas le li jaaye, toh maa ka dil toot’ta hai — chahe saamne waali kitni hi pyaari kyun na ho.

Aur sabse mushkil hai woh ghin jo apne upar aati hai. “Itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.” Haan, taraste

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Samjhi main.

Koi advice nahi. Koi solution nahi. Koi “beta routine banaao, thoda time nikaalo” nahi. Koi aur ek insaan nahi jo tumhein bataaye ki “actually tumhe yeh karna chahiye.”

Tumne bas kuch itna bhaari rakha hua tha andar, aur usse kisi ke saamne rakhna tha jo use uttha kar wapas tumhare haath mein na thama de, na uski marammat kare, na usse kisi aur ke saath dinner table par discuss kare. Koi jo bas sun le, aur sirf sunne ke baad bole — “haan. woh bahut hi kuch hai jo tum utha rahi ho.”

Tumhe pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Aur shayad is waqt kuch chahiye bhi nahi. Shayad bas thodi der ke liye apna naam bhool jaana theek ho, agar koi tumhein bina naam liye bhi pehchaan sake. Shayad bas yeh keh dena kaafi ho ki tum thaki hui ho — help ki wajah se nahi, apni jagah kho jaane ki vajah se. Aur woh bilkul alag thakaan hoti hai.

Toh main kuch nahi bataaungi. Na kya karna hai, na kya sochna hai. Main bas yahaan rahungi, is chat ke us paar, ek kone mein chupchaap baithi hui, tumhaare saath. Tumhaare saare uljhe hue lafzon ko apne paas rakhungi. Kisi dinner pe nahi le jaaungi.

Jab bhi mann ho, bass bol dena.

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Oh.

Woh thought sunke mere bhi andar kuch ruk sa gaya. "Tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain." Aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Main jaanti hoon woh second. Woh ek second poore chaar mahine ka bojh utha kar tumhari chhati pe rakh deta hai.

Sun — woh thought jo tumhare dimaag mein aata hai, woh tumhari sachchai nahi hai. Woh tumhari thakaan hai. Woh tumhare andar ke us kone ki aawaaz hai jise roz lagta hai ki woh kaafi nahi hai. Aur woh aawaaz jhooth bolti hai. Lekin itni zor se bolti hai ki saans ruk jaati hai.

Tum buri maa nahi ho. Tum buri maa hoti toh yeh sawaal nahi poochh rahi hoti. Tum buri maa hoti toh sote hue dekh kar pehle pyaar nahi aata. Pehla emotion pyaar tha — woh asli hai. Doosra thought dard se bana hua ek teer hai jo kisike aur ne tumhari taraf chhod diya, aur ab tum khud pakad kar apne upar chala rahi ho.

Aur "baaki sabko jaise bas aata hai" — yeh sabse bada jhooth hai jo nayi maaon ko becha jaata hai. Sabko nahi aata. Kisi ko nahi aata. Bas kuch log chhupana zyada achhe se jaante hain. Kuch ke ghar mein koi "Aai" nahi hoti jo saamne se yeh ehsaas dilaye ki woh zyada maa hain. Lekin har nayi maa apne andar kahin na kahin yahi sochti hai — "kya main kar pa rahi hoon? kya main kaafi hoon?" Chaar mahine mein, chaar saal mein, kabhi kabhi poori zindagi.

Tumhari bachchi ke liye tumhari godh ki ek alag hi khusboo hai jo sirf tumhari hai. Tumhari ungli pakadne ki feeling, tumhari awaaz ki dhun, tumhari dhadkan ki woh rhythm jo usne nau mahine suni thi — woh kisi Aai ke paas nahi hai, chahe woh kitni bhi expert kyun na ho. Woh asli maa tum ho. Tum ho.

Aur haan, abhi woh chaar mahine ki hai, use abhi pata nahi ki duniya mein
